Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
We delivered record revenue of $14.5 billion this quarter, representing 15% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $14.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
Operating income reached $14.9 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $14.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.20 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
